name: 21x9_2560x1080_hud_shift
description: 2560x1080 (21:9) borderless gameplay capture showing Genshin's ultrawide HUD inward horizontal shift (+72 px X).
notes: Measured on 01_game.png (2560x1080) with OpenCV Sobel radial-gradient circle fit (bilinear sub-pixel search excluding Paimon/N sectors: cx=241.0, cy=124.0, r=106.5; integer grid cx=240.5, cy=123.5, r=107.0) and TM_CCOEFF_NORMED cross-correlation of 6 top-left HUD chrome icons (Paimon face NCC=0.9806, book NCC=0.9646, quest flag NCC=0.9500, eye NCC=0.9927, coop NCC=0.9544) plus Paimon hair connected-component bbox ([108,24,56,55] vs 16:9 [36,24,56,55]), all confirming an exact +72 px X, +0 px Y HUD shift relative to 1920x1080.
